summary: Implemented GeneralizedWassersteinDiceLoss in monai/losses/dice.py (after GeneralizedDiceLoss, with numpy and torch.nn.functional imports and the generalized_wasserstein_dice alias), exported it from monai/losses/__init__.py, and added tests/test_generalized_wasserstein_dice_loss.py covering the binary and empty-class cases, numpy/tensor equivalence, max normalization, non-square ValueError, and the alias. Nothing was run or committed, per the instructions. The batch-of-two example was checked by hand: TP 0.8, D 2.4, loss about 0.333. One pre-existing line in dice.py (line 36, DiceLoss docstring) exceeds 120 columns; the new lines do not.
